svg.title: Eventiva layer 0, group 2
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-19: S6: Map PostHog and OpenTelemetry support across web, native and backend. COMPLETED. Captured Linear: Done. 2026-11-17T15:28:29.172Z: later-status: Live capability-study issue retains historical Done, not EVE-60 implementation acceptance. The later decision records the owner's hourly rotation with automatic trusted-issuer renewal, no user-visible failure or action replay/drop, and UTC boundary/multi-epoch tests. Only pseudonyms may leave the process with per-request opt-in and current consent/release; raw SDK headers remain forbidden. Dedicated server-only tenant/destination/purpose keys are design-authorized, not provisioned; production remains denied. The source capture stays historical and the later cited annotation supersedes only the lifetime-pending proposal. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-19#comment-f9740a5b-d126-4a55-8000-12bf9971a349, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1e940-37a3-7691-a5c0-e935b711c99a#M-034zDqigs0qoRlB2tOAQYo. 0 prerequisites; 1 unlocks.
